name: @kud/cli-shot
description: Automatic screenshots and recordings of interactive CLIs — pty capture, terminal emulation, PNG, asciicast, a web player, GIF or MP4 out

scripts.example:casts: node dist/cli.js --out examples/casts --format cast -- node examples/harbour.mjs
scripts.example:web: node dist/cli.js --out examples/web --format web --title harbour -- node examples/harbour.mjs
scripts.example:gif: node dist/cli.js --out examples/gif --format gif --title harbour -- node examples/harbour.mjs
